title: PICBench: Benchmarking LLMs for Photonic Integrated Circuits Design
problem: LLMs show promise for digital chip design automation but photonic integrated circuit design remains unexplored; PIC design is time-consuming and repetitive.
motivation: Automation of PIC design generation could accelerate circuit design and reduce errors in photonic systems.
method: PICBench provides benchmark framework for evaluating LLM-based PIC netlist generation, assesses syntax and functionality via automatic simulation comparison against expert solutions, tests various LLMs and prompt engineering strategies.
key_novelty: First LLM benchmarking and evaluation framework specifically for photonic integrated circuit design automation.
contributions: PICBench benchmark with dozens of PIC design problems from device to circuit level
Automatic evaluation via simulation comparison to expert solutions
Comparative analysis of multiple LLMs for PIC design
Evaluation of prompt engineering techniques for circuit generation

metrics.accuracy: LLM correctness evaluated via simulation comparison

limitations: Specific LLM performance results and key research gaps not detailed in abstract.
primary_theme: LLM benchmarking for photonic circuit design
